newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Leefung-Asco unit in HK$160 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Leefung-Asco unit in HK$160 mln loan.

text.p: Leefung-Asco Printers Ltd, a unit of Leefung-Asco Printers Holdings Ltd (LAPH), has launched a HK$160 million term loan/revolving credit facility, arranger Banque Nationale de Paris ' Hong Kong branch said.

The facility comprises a HK$112 million term loan and a HK$48 million revolving credit. Both tranches have a final maturity of three years, and can be extended for another two years subject to the extension option.
The deal, which is guaranteed by Leefung-Asco Printers Holdings Ltd, pays a margin of 125 basis points over the one-, two-, three- or six-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are 65 basis points for lead managers committing HK$30-40 million and 55 basis points for managers committing HK$15-20 million.
There is a commitment fee of 35 basis points if the facility is less than 50 percent utilised or 27.5 basis points if 50 percent or more is utilised.

Proceeds will be used to partly refinance the short term debts of LAPH and its group companies and to provide financing to the LAPH Group to meet with its facility expansion and general working capital.
